description: This source file defines an enum `EventKitAuthorization` with static methods to determine read and write access permissions based on `EKAuthorizationStatus`. It encapsulates authorization logic related to EventKit access permissions.

methods.name: allowsRead
methods.description: Checks if the read permission is granted based on the EKAuthorizationStatus value.

methods.name: allowsWrite
methods.description: Checks if the write permission is granted based on the EKAuthorizationStatus value.
